name: boar_idle
prompt: The giant boar stands on all four hooves breathing heavily, flanks rising and falling, bristly mane twitching, snorting small puffs of steam from the snout, tail flicking.

name: boar_paw
prompt: The giant boar stays in place and angrily scrapes the ground with one front hoof twice, head lowered, tusks forward, snorting steam, ready to charge.

name: boar_run
prompt: The giant boar charges at full speed in place toward the right (treadmill run, it stays in place): powerful galloping cycle, head low, tusks forward, mane bouncing.

name: boar_stun
prompt: The giant boar is dazed after crashing into a wall: it sways on wobbly legs, head drooping and shaking, eyes half closed, then recovers to standing.

name: snake_move
prompt: The snake slithers in place toward the right (it stays in place): smooth S-shaped waves travel along its body, head raised and steady, tongue flicking.

name: snake_lunge
prompt: The snake coils back, then strikes forward to the right with its head and open mouth, fangs showing, then pulls back to its starting pose.

name: bat_fly
prompt: The bat hovers in place flapping its leathery wings up and down in a fast steady rhythm, body bobbing slightly, red eyes glowing.

name: satyr_walk
prompt: The satyr walks in place toward the right (treadmill walk, he stays in place) on his goat legs, swaggering, the wooden club in his right hand in every frame.

name: satyr_idle
prompt: The satyr stands menacingly, breathing, bouncing slightly on his goat legs, tapping the wooden club in his right hand, grinning.
